howToAdd: Copy this file to bind-rules.json in the active store (~/.resolve/<workspace>/ in plug-and-play, or repo .resolve when present). Each rule is one object. require = this screen/slot must use this exact master name or id. forbid = do not place that status or name. prefer = rank this library above that one. Unknown ids fail validation — never guess. Rules never change by themselves; approve a SOCI proposal with: npm run resolve -- approve <id> --who <name>
